instructions.text: Take a can of lobster, skim off all the oil on the surface, and chop the meat up coarsely on a flat dish
Prepare the same way six heads of celery
Mix a teaspoonful of mustard into a smooth paste with a little vinegar
Add yolks of two fresh eggs and a tablespoonful of butter, creamed
Add a small teaspoonful of salt, the same of pepper, a quarter of a teaspoonful of cayenne pepper, a gill of vinegar, and the mashed yolks of two hard-boiled eggs
Mix a small portion of the dressing with the celery and meat
Garnish with the green tops of celery and a hard-boiled egg, cut into thin rings

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take a can of lobster, skim off all the oil on the surface, and chop the meat up coarsely on a flat dish
2. Prepare the same way six heads of celery
3. Mix a teaspoonful of mustard into a smooth paste with a little vinegar
4. Add yolks of two fresh eggs and a tablespoonful of butter, creamed
5. Add a small teaspoonful of salt, the same of pepper, a quarter of a teaspoonful of cayenne pepper, a gill of vinegar, and the mashed yolks of two hard-boiled eggs
6. Mix a small portion of the dressing with the celery and meat
7. Turn the remainder over all
8. Garnish with the green tops of celery and a hard-boiled egg, cut into thin rings
